properties.answer: Change it everywhere — a hint names the call to make next rather than trailing the skill name in brackets. (Anthony, 2026-07-31.)
properties.context_setter: Nothing satisfies requirement “A hint that names a skill must name it as the next CALL, not as a parenthetical — a citation is read as attribution, not instruction”
properties.question: When reflow2 tells an agent which skill to use, it currently mentions the name in brackets at the end — and agents read that as a footnote rather than an instruction. Do you want the wording changed everywhere to say plainly "do this next", or leave it as it is?
